Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Bargain trip mode now requests a Lifestream aethernet warp to Sapphire Avenue Exchange after arriving on each world. Added a TravelingToMarketArea trip state before WaitingForMarketBoard, so the Market Board wait begins only after the Sapphire Avenue warp has been requested and given time to complete.
